signals.content: A local evidence system for AI work—unifying ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Gemini, and agent histories into one searchable, auditable archive.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 70. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Sinity/Polylogue
A local evidence system for AI work that aggregates outputs and interaction histories from ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other agents into a single searchable, auditable archive. It aims to improve traceability, reduce duplication, and support strategic OSINT analysis while preserving uncertainties inherent in model outputs.

signals.content: AI Agent Infrastructure Expert - Building the future of autonomous AI systems
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; AI infrastructure relevance. Final score: 66. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: Retsumdk/Retsumdk – AI Agent Infrastructure Expert. Focuses on designing modular, interoperable components for autonomous AI systems, leveraging open-source models, secure APIs, and distributed compute. Current capabilities include task orchestration, real-time data ingestion, and adaptive policy enforcement, but performance varies across domains and depends on external data quality. Ongoing research targets scalable governance, privacy-preserving inference, and resilience against adversarial manipulation.

signals.title: @MarioNawfal: 🚨🇺🇸🇨🇳 A chatbot hallucination nearly had American troops boarding a Chinese ship in the middle of the Iran war An analyst at Special Operati
signals.content: 🚨🇺🇸🇨🇳 A chatbot hallucination nearly had American troops boarding a Chinese ship in the middle of the Iran war An analyst at Special Operations Command asked an AI about a ship's manifest, the bot blended open-source material with classified signals intelligence and decided the vessel was carrying NUCLEAR WEAPON components, and then the same analyst used AI again to write it up as a formal intelligence report that went out across the military. Planes were in the air and armed personnel were preparing to board before somebody finally checked how the report was built and found the whole thing was, in one source's words, entirely false. Another source put it more bluntly, saying it almost started a war, which is not an exaggeration when the target is a Chinese ship. Hegseth's AI strategy in January promised to eliminate bureaucratic barriers and put these models in the hands of three million personnel at every classification level, and this is what that looks like when nobody has agreed on how to verify the output. One official's summary deserves a plaque somewhere in the Pentagon: AI allows you to get to a bad idea faster. Targeting is the next frontier for these tools, with no rules yet for how a human in the loop prevents killing the wrong people, so the question isn't whether this happens again but whether the next one gets caught BEFORE the boarding party leaves... Source: CNN / Writer: Daniel, Lucas

signals.brief_en:
Title: ontoAI‑weishu/ontology-agent-skill-en
Brief: Ontology Agent (English edition) enables a company to be modelled as an ontology. It supports a team of up to 24 AI‑department staff, defines 159 distinct actions, and offers eight pre‑built industry packs. The system is bilingual by default (English) with full Chinese localisation available via the –lang en|zh flag. OSINT analysts should note the modest team size and limited action set, which may constrain scalability in larger enterprises.

العنوان: ontoAI‑weishu/ontology-agent-skill-en
ملخص: يتيح وكيل الأنطولوجيا (الإصدار الإنجليزي) تحويل الشركة إلى أنطولوجيا. يدعم فريقًا يصل إلى 24 موظفًا في قسم الذكاء الاصطناعي، ويحدد 159 إجراءً مختلفًا، ويوفر ثمانية حزم صناعية جاهزة. النظام ثنائي اللغة افتراضيًا (إنجليزي) مع دعم كامل للصينية عبر خيار –lang en|zh. يجب على محللي الاستخبارات المفتوحة (OSINT) ملاحظة أن حجم الفريق المحدود ومجموعة الإجراءات قد يحدان من قابلية التوسع في المؤسسات الأكبر.

signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Vulgarcin/agent-history-index

This brief documents verifiable milestones in the AI agent ecosystem. It tracks major model releases, capability upgrades, policy shifts, and notable incidents that have been confirmed by multiple open‑source intelligence (OSINT) sources. Each entry includes the date, the responsible organization, a concise description of the change, and the confidence level (high, medium, low) based on source corroboration. The index is intended for strategic monitoring and risk assessment, not for speculative forecasting.

signals.title: LG TV flaws could let attackers listen in, even in standby mode - Malwarebytes
signals.content: LG TV flaws could let attackers listen in, even in standby mode - Malwarebytes Malwarebytes
signals.score_reason: monitored AI source. Final score: 32. Freshness: source age 12.55d.
signals.brief_en: Malwarebytes reports that several LG smart‑TV models contain firmware vulnerabilities that allow remote code execution and activation of the built‑in microphone, even when the device appears to be in standby. Exploits could enable eavesdropping on users’ conversations without visual cues. LG has acknowledged the issue and is working on patches, but users should apply firmware updates promptly and consider disabling the microphone when not in use.
signals.brief_ar: أفادت Malwarebytes أن بعض طرز تلفزيونات LG الذكية تحتوي على ثغرات في البرنامج الثابت تسمح بتنفيذ شيفرة عن بُعد وتفعيل الميكروفون المدمج حتى عندما يكون الجهاز في وضع الاستعداد. يمكن لهذه الثغرات أن تمكّن المهاجمين من التنصت على محادثات المستخدمين دون أي إشارات مرئية. أقرت LG بوجود المشكلة وتعمل على إصدار تصحيحات، وينبغي على المستخدمين تحديث البرنامج الثابت فورًا والنظر في تعطيل الميكروفون عندما لا يكون قيد الاستخدام.
